citations.text: Hu et al. (2020). Open Graph Benchmark: Datasets for Machine Learning on Graphs. NeurIPS.

description: Large heterogeneous graph of academic citations and collaborations from Microsoft Academic Graph. Contains 4 node types: papers, authors, institutions, and fields of study. 5 edge types: author-paper (writes), author-institution (affiliated-with), paper-venue (published-in), and topic edges. Used extensively for heterogeneous graph neural network benchmarking and node classification tasks.
name: Open Graph Benchmark - MAG (Academic Graph)
